text:
marie (docs): quick question — i'm drafting the public deprecation note for the legacy API shape. want to keep it short and actionable. must-haves i have so far:
• clear timeline (sunset date + grace period)
• exact migration snippet for the simplest case
• list of redirects and broken-links to update
• SDK snippet updates and a fallback note
who can take the sdk snippets + a pinable example? cc @ajay (eng) @taylor (devex)

ajay (eng): i can take SDK snippets. i'll update TS + py, and add a tiny compatibility example that shows `oldRequest.payload` -> `input` rename. will add a test in the snippets smoke harness. i'll open a PR today.

taylor (devex): thanks! when you open the PR can you include a `before -> after` code diff we can paste into the migration guide? also want one-liner copy for the top of the docs page: "If you use the legacy request shape, update to the new `input` parameter before JUNE 1."

sam (product): timeline looks fine. let's set the public sunset for 2026-07-15 and an internal hard-stop for 2026-08-15. marketing will need the short copy taylor mentioned + a 2-line FAQ.

marie (docs): filing the redirects: i found three pages referencing the legacy endpoint that need permanent redirects:
- /api/legacy-call -> /api/generate (we'll set 301)
- /examples/old-chat -> /examples/chat-new-format
- /guides/embeds-v1 -> /guides/embeds (note: need to verify vector dim note)
can ci-bot run link-check on merge?

ci-bot: scheduled link-check job queued: docs/link-check/3971234567. will post results as comments on PRs.

ajay (eng): PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1427 — contains TS + py snippets, unit tests for snippet compilation, and a short compat example. i left a TODO for the embed dim note since that's product territory.

taylor (devex): reviewing now. one nit: the TS snippet still uses `createClient()` without auth example; we should show a one-line `env var` auth example to avoid confusion. also adding the diff to the migration guide now.

marie (docs): perfect. i'll draft the deprecation notice copy and include the code diff taylor added. plan to send a pre-announce to internal channels on 2026-06-01 and public on 2026-06-08. can we aim to have PRs merged by 2026-05-28?

sam (product): yes, product + legal ok with those dates. after PR merge we'll run the link-check and smoke tests. if anything fails, we fallback to a staged rollout and add a banner on /docs.

ajay (eng): FYI — one edgecase for model swaps: if a customer pins an old model id that's been aliased, we should add a note in the migration guide saying pinned model ids will continue to route to the compatible variant for 90 days. i'll add that paragraph to the PR.

marie (docs): lovely — that exact phrasing helps. thanks everyone, i'll open the docs PR with the deprecation copy + redirect map after taylor's review. ping here when your PRs are ready and ci-bot posts green. :raised_hands:
